checks.title: Clean-checkout runtime reproducibility
checks.requirement: Every CourtOS runtime input, asset, read contract, and build script needed by a clean checkout is tracked or reproducibly materialized by a documented build step.

checks.title: Production API adapter
checks.requirement: The deployed runtime serves every /api/courtos, /api/household, and /api/council-room contract through a production-capable adapter rather than relying only on Vite development or preview middleware.

checks.title: Hermetic spatial materialization
checks.requirement: Spatial build outputs are reproducible without an undocumented sibling repository or machine-specific home-directory state.

checks.title: Admitted data only
checks.requirement: Candidate, provisional, fixture, and presentation-only records cannot silently become UI authority.

checks.title: House-agnostic identity and asset resolution
checks.requirement: Names, heraldry, portraits, people, responsibilities, and room population work for any admitted House without Pearwick/Holtcross-only branches or wrong-person fallbacks.

checks.title: Authority and knowledge boundaries
checks.requirement: The runtime enforces House isolation, identifies its versioned player session and source-resolved acting Head, distinguishes assignment planning from execution and House-record inspection from actor knowledge, and fails closed for correspondence, dialogue, and runtime commands outside admitted authority.

checks.title: Loading, unavailable, empty, degraded, and error states
checks.requirement: Every runtime dependency and drill-down has honest bounded fallback behavior with recovery or actionable diagnostics.

checks.title: Client payload minimization and embedding safety
checks.requirement: The client does not download out-of-scope realm data or internal identifiers merely to filter locally, and embedded surfaces use appropriate origin and sandbox controls.

checks.title: Module boundaries and type safety
checks.requirement: CourtOS presentation, navigation, source adapters, and projections are separable, typed, reviewable, and testable without monolithic coupling.

checks.title: Performance and asset budgets
checks.requirement: Bundle size, first meaningful room render, portrait/heraldry loading, spatial payload, and map responsiveness have measured budgets.

checks.title: Reproducible runtime evidence
checks.requirement: A UAT defect can be tied to a content-aware build identity, route, House, actor, source contract, console/network evidence, and exact runtime inputs.

checks.title: CI, deployment smoke, and rollback
checks.requirement: CI reproduces the candidate from clean inputs, exercises production endpoints and the browser entry, and preserves an identifiable rollback artifact.
